summary: Iteration 5 — BDesigner Website CMS Phase 1 E2E verification (backend + frontend). Backend pytest (11/11 passed) covers admin login/role, admin authorization (401 no-token + 403 client-token) on all /api/admin/cms/* and media upload endpoints, CMS draft shape (all 7 sections with expected counts: trust_indicator=4, construction_step=8, guarantee=6, service_area=12, homeowner_review=6, comparison_feature=9, faq=6; meta has last_saved/last_published), media upload happy path (POST /api/admin/media/upload returns /api/media/bdesigner/cms/image/<uuid>.png that serves image/png), .txt/empty rejections (400), and the full draft→preview→publish→revert→publish round-trip proving (a) preview shows draft, (b) public GET /api/homepage/sections stays clean until publish, (c) publish updates public, (d) cleanup revert restores original title. Frontend Playwright verified: /admin/login renders admin-login-form on dark bg with NO public navbar, login as admin@bdesigner.com routes to /admin, admin-panel shows all 4 sidebar groups (MAIN/COMMERCIAL/WEBSITE/CONFIGURATION), only Website CMS is enabled, top bar has Preview/Save Draft/Publish, CMS tabs row (Homepage/Projects/.../SEO) renders and non-Homepage tabs show 'later phase' placeholder, cms-homepage loads the draft, Hero section has Hero Video / Fallback Image / Logo media fields + duration + 3 states, Guarantee expand-collapse works, editing cms-guarantee-heading marks 'Unsaved changes', Save Draft persists (survives reload), Publish updates public homepage / with the test heading, Preview opened in a new tab (/?cms_preview=1) rendered the DRAFT heading, revert+publish restored the original ('Assurance You Can Trust') on the public site, unauth /admin redirects to /admin/login after auth-me fails (dark login shell only, no public navbar), and /?cms_preview=1 in a fresh no-token context correctly falls back to the published content (no draft leakage). Test edit was fully cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: AdminPanel.jsx is 345 lines and mixes admin shell + sidebar + CMS editor + collapsibles + icon picker in one file. As more CMS tabs (Projects/Homeowner Stories/etc) get built out, split into /admin/AdminShell.jsx, /admin/cms/HomepageEditor.jsx and a shared MediaField component to prevent >700-line growth.

Non-blocking: /api/admin/cms/homepage/preview requires admin auth, but the public Home.jsx fetches it only when URLSearchParams.cms_preview=1 AND a token exists in local/session storage. Any leaked admin token in a shared browser would render draft content publicly for that user — consider a short-lived preview cookie/nonce instead of reusing the JWT for /preview access.

Non-blocking: cms_publish (website_cms.py:229-244) deletes then insert_many per section without a Mongo transaction — if the insert fails between the delete and insert calls, the published section is left empty. Wrap in a session/transaction or stage into a temp collection then rename.

Non-blocking: seed_admin logs the bootstrap password at WARNING level to backend logs — acceptable one-time, but consider also flagging must_change_password=true (already set) and rate-limiting /api/auth/login for the admin email.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth /api/auth/login response is FLAT (has id/name/email/role/token at top level, NO 'user' wrapper) — assert data['role'] not data['user']['role']. AdminPanel initial open-state is { hero: true, guarantee: true } but on Homepage the Guarantee card renders collapsed until first click; treat presence of [data-testid=cms-guarantee-heading] as the truth of expanded state. window.open('/?cms_preview=1') triggers Home.jsx to call /admin/cms/homepage/preview only when bd_token is present in storage — a fresh context correctly falls back to published. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_website_cms.py (uses tiny 1x1 PNG base64 for real upload). Existing regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_bdesigner_public.py still relevant for public content.
